name: button
description: CTA atom. 'primary' renders the brand's button (site-config theme: fischer = 2px black outline, fills black on hover; fischertechnik = solid blue). 'arrow' renders a bare 24px right-arrow icon (label becomes aria-label) and, inside a banner, stretches the link over the whole banner.

style.description: 'Text link' = label with a small arrow, no box.

view.name: Button
view.notes: primary class set comes from the active brand theme (CSS vars set from site-config.button_style): outline = transparent bg, 2px solid var(--color-text), text var(--color-text), hover bg var(--color-text) + white text (0.3s); solid = bg var(--color-primary), 2px transparent border, white text, hover darken. Both: radius 0, padding 5px 18px, font-weight 600 16px/28px, height ~42px. arrow = inline icon-arrow-right.svg (24px, currentColor), visually-hidden label. secondary = outline in var(--color-text) on every brand (2px, transparent, hover filled) — ft 'Alle miniMINT Modelle entdecken'. text-link = no box: label 18/28 600 var(--color-text) + trailing 16px arrow, pr 6, hover primary ('Zum e-Learning', 'Produktvarianten', 'Bilddaten herunterladen').
